name: Le Meridien Mahabaleshwar Resort & Spa
positioning: Spa resort on 27 acres of evergreen forest in the Western Ghats, with an infinity pool overlooking the valley and suites with forest or valley-view balconies
best_for: Couples who want a forest spa retreat with balcony suites
Families who want a kids' pool with slides and a complimentary Family Club
Travelers exploring Mahabaleshwar's temples, viewpoints and waterfalls

facts.text: The resort sits on 27 acres of evergreen forest in the Western Ghats.
The resort is near Mahabaleshwar attractions including Krishnabai and Shiva Temple, Arthur's Seat, Mapro Gardens and the local market.
Suites have private balconies with views of the forest or valley.
Room amenities include a marble soaking tub and 24-hour room service.
The Tranquility, Sanctuary and Serenity Suites include club lounge access.
Explore Spa has a Hammam and a Vichy shower.
Chingari serves North Indian, Awadhi and Hyderabadi cuisine from a show kitchen.
The complimentary Family Club offers pottery, painting and slime making.
The hotel runs a nature trail and sapling plantation as part of an afforestation initiative.
The hotel is LEED New Construction certified.
The nearby Helen's Point trek is a 2 km downhill walk through the forest with valley views.

highlights.text: The infinity pool overlooks the valley.
Woods - The Forest Dining Experience serves Asian tapas and Japanese cuisine in the middle of the forest under the night sky.
The Tranquility Suite has an outdoor shower.
There is a kids' leisure pool with slides.
Lingmala Waterfall is near the resort.

considerations.text: Pune International Airport is approximately 135 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes that seasonal weather can affect outdoor activities.
